summary.intent: Spike and replace the callisto add wizard's interactive prompts (dialoguer plus a hand-written Ctrl-C state machine in tty.rs) with inquire, mapping interrupt/cancel to one CliError variant that exits 130, and drop the ctrlc/rustix runtime deps. Trail #487, as a draft PR superseding #638's tty.rs design.
summary.outcome: inquire 0.9.4 (0.9.5 was only 8 days old) met the wizard's needs. The add wizard and init were ported, dialoguer/ctrlc/rustix runtime deps removed, a Cancelled error variant added, and an editor SIGINT guard added. All 13 pty tests, cargo test -p callisto-cli (701 ok), just lint and just audit pass. A signed checkpoint was committed locally; the push, draft PR, trail link, and lead report are not done yet.

repo: inquire 0.9.5 was under the two-week stable-age rule, so 0.9.4 (MIT) was pinned with default features disabled.
Fetching new crates writes to ~/.cargo/registry and just audit needs ~/.cargo/advisory-dbs; both are blocked by the sandbox and must run unsandboxed.
pty tests need /dev/ptmx, which the sandbox blocks, so they must also run unsandboxed.
runner::child_command leaves the editor in the same process group as Callisto, so a line-mode editor's Ctrl-C SIGINT reaches Callisto and killed it until a guard was added.
init still prompted under --format json on a terminal; routing it through the same Prompts::allowed gate was a one-line sibling fix, and the init spec criterion and changeset were updated to match.
The duplicate unicode-width dependency is already on main and is not introduced by this change.
docs/specs/cli.json holds add/init acceptance criteria that had to be updated alongside the prompt behaviour changes.
workflow: Check the three-dot diff against origin/main rather than the two-dot diff when the base branch has moved since the PR branch was cut.
Write the failing pty test first for the editor-SIGINT behaviour, confirm it fails, then implement the guard.
When a filtered test or lint run exits 101 with no visible failure, rerun with the full log captured.

friction: The lead's reference worktree was off-limits to this isolated session, so the lead's uncommitted edits had to be reimplemented from the description.
Multiple sandbox restrictions (cargo registry, advisory db, ptmx) forced several unsandboxed reruns.
Test and lint runs exited 101 with no failure lines in the filtered output, which required rerunning with full logs.
The commit step took several attempts (format and stage, then signed commit).
open_items: Merge the latest origin/main, push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, confirm with git ls-remote, link trail #487, and open the draft PR with entire trail ci-pr.
Write the PR body (via gh pr edit --body-file) stating it supersedes #638's tty.rs design, with lines removed vs added, deps removed/added, test results, and anything inquire can't do.
Fold in the lead's new items mentioned after the checkpoint, which were not visible in the transcript.
Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines: PR, sha, what was run.
